tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Lists the servers and Kubernetes clusters in the signed-in Opservo workspace, with each one's agent_id, kind (linux server or kubernetes cluster), hostname, display name and whether it is online. Archived servers are left out.

tools.name: get_server_overview
tools.description: Returns a snapshot of one server: CPU %, 1-minute load average and core count, memory %, disk usage per mount, uptime, the five processes using the most CPU, and the number of detected services and apps.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Returns the open issues Opservo has detected on one server, ranked by severity (critical, warning, info), each with a plain-English description and the suggested fix. Can be filtered to one severity.

tools.name: get_log_summary
tools.description: Returns the latest AI-written summary of one server's logs and its five most frequent log patterns from the last hour (nginx, Apache, Laravel, Docker, PM2, systemd), with counts and when each was last seen.

tools.name: get_incident_timeline
tools.description: Returns a time-ordered list of correlated events on one server over a look-back window — service crashes, error and warning spikes in the logs, CPU/memory/disk thresholds crossed, SSL certificates nearing expiry, and newly detected issues — with the likely root cause when one is identified.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Returns the services detected on one server (systemd units, Docker containers, PM2 processes) and whether each is running.

tools.name: get_domains
tools.description: Returns the domains served by one server's web server configuration and the number of days until each SSL certificate expires.

tools.name: get_kubernetes_snapshot
tools.description: Returns the state of one Kubernetes cluster connected to Opservo: version, node conditions and capacity, workloads with ready counts and restarts, problem pods with their reason, last exit code and recent log lines, and recent warning events. tools.name: get_recent_commands
tools.description: Returns the commands recently run on one server through Opservo (terminal, quick actions, approved fixes, automation), sorted newest to oldest, with source, exit code and the start of their output.
